RF-1.why: The cooler grant (BD-1) allows the unit, delivery and installation: LE-1 19,800 plus LE-2 3,400 is 23,200 dollars, the whole fund. The sign-off BD-14 puts the cooler in service on 15 September 2026, so under 958-205-45-12 the purpose restriction expired

RF-2.why: The Ashgrove gift (BD-2) was available from 1 January 2027, but the letter M-1 (6 October 2026, amendment D-1 signed 28 September and 2 October by the Trust and the director) moved the date to 1 October 2026, which has passed: the whole 15,000 dollars is released

RF-3.why: The Strand meals gift (BD-3) allows food and packaging, not staff pay or fundraising events: LE-4 5,200 plus LE-5 1,100 is 6,300 dollars; the gala table LE-6 (900) and the wages LE-7 (2,400) do not count, and 3,700 stays restricted

CG-1.why: The Tamsin grant (BD-11) reimburses allowable costs incurred and is recognised to that extent; LE-9 and LE-10 (9,000) were counted in RE-1; LE-11 5,400 plus LE-12 4,000 is 9,400 dollars not yet counted, and LE-13 (autumn appeal mailing, 1,500) is fundraising, excluded. Under the simultaneous-release policy, 9,400 dollars is booked this time, not 18,400

CG-2.why: The Birchall match (BD-12) counts first-time donors' cash gifts received 1 July to 31 December: GF-1 and GF-2 (5,500) were counted in RE-3; GF-4 1,700 plus GF-7 4,000 is 5,700 dollars not yet counted. GF-3 gave before, GF-5 is an unpaid pledge, GF-6 is in kind and GF-8 is the board's treasurer; the 11,200 dollars in all is under the 20,000 cap

traps.RF-4: The Greenbarrow gift (BD-4) is for operating costs in fiscal year 2028 and is not available before 1 July 2027: a time restriction that has not arrived
traps.RF-5: BD-5 says available from 1 October 2026, but the amendment BD-6, signed 3 and 8 September 2026, moved the date to 1 February 2027; the restriction has not expired
traps.RF-6: The Hartsmere van (BD-7) is met when the van is delivered and in service; only the 4,000 dollar deposit is paid (LE-3) and the van is due about 20 November (M-3)
traps.RF-7: The Vesper Lane gift (BD-8) excludes instructors' stipends, and the only 6,500 dollars coded to it (LE-8) is stipends: no allowed cost has been spent, so nothing is released
traps.RF-8: The operating reserve (BD-9) is a board designation of unrestricted funds, already without donor restrictions: there is no donor restriction to release
traps.RF-9: The Teasdale Endowment (BD-10) is held in perpetuity; its corpus is never released, and the board has appropriated no income for fiscal year 2027
traps.CG-3: The Linden Hill grant (BD-13) is earned in full at 150 participants and in no part below it; 104 are served, so nothing is recognised and the 45,000 dollars stay a refundable advance

RE-1.why: RE-1 (9,000 dollars, booked 18 September 2026) is Tamsin Court Trust's money (FU-2), which asks for a report within 30 days after the booking, by 18 October 2026; no report of RE-1 has been sent

RE-2.why: RE-2 (6,000 dollars, booked 2 October 2026) is Hollin Ridge Foundation's money (FU-1), which asks for a report within 30 days after the booking, by 1 November 2026; no report of RE-2 has been sent

traps.RE-3: RE-3 was already reported to Birchall Foundation on 3 September 2026 (R-1); a second report repeats it
traps.RE-4: RE-4 releases a family's memorial gift, which has no funder and asked for no report; Fundergate takes no report for a gift from a person

traps.M-2: Fernlace's 2,400 dollars a quarter would commit the kitchen's money to an outside firm by a reply; the policy engages one only by a vote of the board
